title: 第23章 和铃央央求追读查看更多章节...
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃展颜一笑，“多谢小齐师兄。”
她蹲下身，解开小麒麟身上的枷锁，神色温柔地摸了摸它的脖子。
“虽然我不能给你绝对的自由，但也绝不会用锁链困住你。”
“我的名字你已经知道了，龙旂阳阳，和铃央央。我叫和铃，小字央央，你也可以唤我阿铃。”
“你呢，小麒麟，我还不知道你的名字呢。”
“吟~吟~”没有名字。
小麒麟高傲地仰着头。
和铃想了想，说道：“鳞介尊神龙，走兽宗麒麟，以后你就叫介宗吧！”
第五齐张了张嘴想说什么，但是见和铃和小麒麟满脸兴奋，他决定闭嘴。
算了，和铃她喜欢给小麒麟起什么名字就起什么名字吧，反正这是她的坐骑。
和小麒麟契约之后，和铃翻身上背，乘着玄墨麒麟在宗门内兜风了几圈。
看着天上如彗星划过的墨绿流光，吕温良直摇头，“如此大张旗鼓，让那些错失了玄墨麒麟的弟子心里怎么想？”
“从前的和铃只是追着夜弦身后跑，就算引起非议，也是混元峰和一尘峰两峰之间的事情，如今怕是要引起大半个宗门的不满了。”
果然，第二天吕温良就收到了不少弟子的投诉。
“宗主，我理解和铃师姐契约了玄墨麒麟的喜悦，但她大半夜都还骑着玄墨麒麟在宗门内跑来跑去，实在影响弟子子夜修炼。”
修行讲究心无杂念，和铃在天上炫耀她的灵兽，他心平气和得下来才怪。
“是啊宗主，和铃师姐此举和在宗门内跑马有何分别？麒麟叫声清亮，都惊到弟子豢养的灵兽了。”
“宗规有言，子夜过后禁止御剑飞行，小麒麟虽然不是飞剑，但也不应该成为例外，不管怎么说，它也是在御空。”
听着大家七嘴八舌的声音，吕温良摆了摆手，说道：“你们说的事情我都知道了，我会派人去提醒和铃，遵守宗门规定，不要在半夜溜麒麟了。”
“多谢宗主。”

“弟子无事了。”
“弟子也没有事了，先告退。”
大家前后脚走出大殿，吕温良派了个弟子去混元峰将此事告知了和铃。
和铃态度良好，保证道：“烦请回去告诉宗主，请他放心，我今夜不带小麒麟出门了。大家投诉我的事情我会记在心上的。”
没想到半夜兜风居然是违反宗门规定的，宗主居然只是让人提醒了她两句，没有惩罚她，看来元婴真君的名头还是好用啊。
“不过我现在是狐假虎威，宗主完全是看在师尊的面子上才对我如此轻拿轻放的，还是要自己晋升元婴境才行。”
舔狗系统忍不住哼了声：【和铃，你以为修炼到元婴境是很容易的一件事情么。】
【你的资质太差了，之前能够修炼到金丹境都是因为系统的帮助。但现在，你放弃了做舔狗任务，你的修为只会一落千丈，这颗金丹即便你不拱手送人，也保不住的。】
和铃没有理会舔狗系统。
她看着面前自己找来的坤舆界如今的地图，拿起朱笔在上面勾了个圈。
星谷秘境！
变天图显示的地方，是现如今的星谷秘境。
“没想到重合起来，竟然是这里。”和铃喃喃道。
星谷秘境只是一个中型秘境，金丹境以上修为的修士就不能进去了。
content_en:
He Ling smiled and said, "Thank you, Senior Brother Xiao Qi."
She knelt down, untied the shackles on the little Qilin, and touched its neck gently.
"Although I cannot give you absolute freedom, I will never trap you with chains."
"You already know my names, Longqi Yangyang, and Heling Yangyang. My name is Heling, with the small Chinese character Yangyang. You can also call me Aling."
"What about you, little Qilin, I don't know your name yet."
"Yin~Yin~" has no name.
Little Qilin raised his head proudly.
He Ling thought for a while and said: "Lin Jie Zun Shenlong, Beast Zong Qilin, from now on you will be called Jie Zong!"
Wu Qi opened his mouth to say something, but seeing He Ling and Xiao Qilin's faces full of excitement, he decided to shut up.
Forget it, He Ling can name the little Qilin whatever she likes. After all, this is her mount.
After making a contract with Xiao Qilin, He Ling turned on his back and rode the Xuanmo Qilin for a few laps in the sect.
Looking at the dark green light streaking across the sky like a comet, Lu Wenliang shook his head, "With such a big fanfare, what do those disciples who missed the Xuanmo Qilin think?"
"In the past, He Ling just ran after Ye Xian. Even if it caused criticism, it was a matter between Hunyuan Peak and Yichen Peak. Now I am afraid that it will cause dissatisfaction among most of the sect."
Sure enough, Lu Wenliang received many complaints from his disciples the next day.
"Sect Master, I understand the joy of contracting the Xuan Mo Qilin with Senior Sister Ling, but she still rides the Xuan Mo Qilin around the sect in the middle of the night, which really affects the disciple Ziye's cultivation."
Cultivation is about keeping the mind clear of distracting thoughts. He Ling is showing off her spiritual beast in the sky. It's strange that he can calm down.
"Yes, Sect Master, what's the difference between what Senior Sister Heling did and running horses in the Sect? The Qilin's cry was so clear that it even shocked the spiritual beasts raised by the disciples."
"The sect rules say that it is forbidden to fly with a sword after midnight. Although the little unicorn is not a flying sword, it should not be an exception. No matter what, it is still flying in the air."
Listening to everyone's chatter, Lu Wenliang waved his hand and said, "I know everything you said. I will send someone to remind He Ling to abide by the sect's regulations and not to wander Qilin in the middle of the night."
"Thank you, Master."
"Disciple is fine."
"Disciple, everything is fine. Please leave first."
Everyone walked out of the hall, and Lu Wenliang sent a disciple to Hunyuan Peak to inform Heling about the matter.
He Ling had a good attitude and promised: "Please go back and tell the sect master, please rest assured that I will not take the little Qilin out tonight. I will keep everyone's complaints against me in mind."
Unexpectedly, going for a ride in the middle of the night was against the sect's regulations. The sect leader only asked her to remind her a few words without punishing her. It seems that the name of the Nascent Soul Master is still useful.
"But now I am a fox pretending to be a tiger. The sect leader treats me so lightly just for the sake of my master. I still have to advance to the Nascent Soul realm myself."
Licking System couldn't help but snorted: [He Ling, do you think it is easy to cultivate to the Nascent Soul Realm? 】
[Your qualifications are too poor. You were able to cultivate to the Golden Core Realm before because of the help of the system. But now, if you give up the task of licking the dog, your cultivation will only plummet. Even if you don't give it away, you can't keep this golden elixir. 】
He Ling ignored the dog-licking system.
She looked at the current map of Kunyu Realm that she had found in front of her, picked up the ink pen and drew a circle on it.
Star Valley Secret Realm!
The place shown in the Sky Changing Map is the current Star Valley Secret Realm.
"I didn't expect that when they overlap, it turns out to be here." He Ling murmured.
The Star Valley Secret Realm is only a medium-sized secret realm, and monks with cultivation levels above the Golden Core Realm cannot enter.
